capabilities.name: agent_capacity.py
capabilities.summary: Advisory host-capacity snapshot (CPU/load/memory-pressure plus Orca worktree counts) for sizing a multi-agent wave; never starts, stops, or signals an agent.

capabilities.name: wiki_edit_guard.py
capabilities.summary: Pre-write barrier for a hand-maintained wiki catalog: rejects a semantic edit that does not bump meta.content_version, and reports up front whether the write will leave the signed manifest pin stale.

capabilities.name: check_wiki_freshness.py
capabilities.summary: Standalone anytime re-check of whether wiki/orca-context-wiki.json still hashes to its signed manifest pin, instead of discovering the drift at the next SessionStart.

capabilities.name: build_startup_bundle.py
capabilities.summary: Reviewed-pack trust anchor: hashes shared sources, summarizes Git authority state, and gates delivery on a three-part storage check (project path, Git common dir, volume UUID).

capabilities.name: orca_readonly_probe.py
capabilities.summary: Exercises ~18 read-only Orca list/status/capability commands and prints labels plus pass/fail only, deliberately withholding account, terminal, and diagnostic payloads.

capabilities.name: tmux_bridge.py
capabilities.summary: Mailbox-style message passing between agents in local tmux panes, treating every received message as untrusted data; --inject (real send-keys typing) is a separate, deliberate action.

capabilities.name: orca-context-bridge
capabilities.summary: Skill that syncs a redacted local Claude/Codex session catalog into an Orca workspace, indexes processes/PRs/wiki into a knowledge graph, and builds bounded startup context.

capabilities.name: local-wiki-catalog
capabilities.summary: Convention for a small hand-reviewed per-project knowledge catalog (pages with id/title/path/summary/status plus typed links) that a graph builder can consume without touching a remote wiki.

capabilities.name: write-containment-guard
capabilities.summary: Pattern of resolving a caller-supplied path and refusing it unless it stays inside one declared root, so a read-only aggregator cannot be argued into writing outside its own output directory.

capabilities.name: validate_reusable_capabilities.py
capabilities.summary: Read-only structural validator for a wiki/reusable-capabilities.json file: schema, depends_on grammar, same-project ref resolution.

capabilities.name: build_cross_project_catalog.py
capabilities.summary: Read-only aggregator: consolidates every Orca project's three public wiki files into one cross-project catalog.

capabilities.name: install_prime_agent.py
capabilities.summary: Project-specific verified installer/auditor for one pinned third-party CLI: digest-verified tarballs, hermetic pinned-toolchain npm ci, durable-receipt-bound TOCTOU hardening, opt-in npm-audit gate. Reference for the TOCTOU pattern, not an entrypoint another project imports.
